Example Reply Placement (fictional), licence DEMO-RA-010; office Room J, Example Square, Demo Nagar. Cambodia chat support, employment visa travel se pehle. Service fee Rs 30,001 plus GST Rs 5,400.18; rounded payable total Rs 35,401, receipt ke saath bank transfer. Employer, agent aur worker ka signed tripartite contract pehle milega. Pravasi Bharatiya Bima Yojana (PBBY) insurance bhi included hai.
